name: tocqueville_comparison
one_line: Compare sessions of the same task class and ask why the dearest one cost more.
problem: Waste hidden inside a single session looks normal; next to a cheaper peer of the same kind it stands out.
design: Group Hamilton profiles by task class (build phase, PR babysit, evidence upload, review).
For each class compute dollars per accepted unit and per-cause shares, and rank sessions against the class median.
For the dearest sessions, list the causes whose dollars exceed the median peer's by more than 2x (numbers and cause keys only, no transcript text).
Emit one candidate per excess cause with the peer session as the suggested 'before/after' pair.

cost_estimate.basis: pure script over already-committed profiles; no model in the loop, so run cost is near zero; needs a task class tag, which is hand-added once per session
cost_estimate.note: Estimate only (unverified). Never counted as a saving.

first_test: Use the audited X1 and Y1 coordinators: if Y1 is cheaper per accepted unit, its difference is the candidate and Y1 is the after arm.
risks: Only five sessions are audited today; with fewer than 3 per class the comparison says little. Class labels are judgement.
